entries.english: Orchard is switched off, so this card leaves out {picked} picked and {sold} sold: {names}. The rands elsewhere on this page still count those sales — only the kilograms here are filtered.

translations.st: Serapa sa difate se timilwe, ka hona karete ena e siea {picked} e kotutsweng le {sold} e rekisitsweng: {names}. Diranta tse ding leqepheng lena di ntse di bala dithekiso tseo — ke dikilograma tsa mona feela tse sefilweng.
translations.ve: Ngade ya miri ya mitshelo yo dzimwa, ngauralo {picked} zwo kaṋwaho na {sold} zwo rengiswaho a zwi katelwi kha khadi iyi: {names}. Mbalo dza rand dziṅwe kha peji iyi dzi kha ḓi vhala idzo thengiso — ndi kg dza hafha fhedzi dzi sa katelwiho.
translations.ts: Ntanga wa mirhi wu timiwile, hikwalaho khadi leri a ri katsi {picked} leswi tshoveriweke ni {sold} leswi xavisiweke: {names}. Tirhandi eka papila leri ti ha hlayela ku xavisa loku — i kg laha ntsena leti nga katsiwiki.

entries.reason: The former sentence claimed Rand figures elsewhere counted these sales. Currency and source holds now make that universal claim invalid; the replacement keeps physical filtering separate from invoice-currency review.
entries.replacementEnglish: Orchard is switched off, so this card leaves out {picked} picked and {sold} sold: {names}. Only the kilograms here are filtered. Money elsewhere follows the recorded invoice currency review.
